question: 列出所有已下架商品的名称和价格

expect.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

question: 哪些客户没有填写邮箱？列出客户编号和名称

question: 账号状态为停用（is_active=0）的客户有哪些？列出客户编号、名称和所在城市

question: 产地（attributes 中的 origin）为杭州的商品有哪些？列出商品名称和价格

question: 有多少条商品评价还没有商家回复？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews WHERE merchant_reply IS NULL

notes: 单值答案，考察 NULL 计数

question: 每个商品分类下各有多少个在售（上架）商品？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: 哪些客户从来没有下过单？列出客户编号和名称

expect.gold_sql: SELECT customer_no, name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: 评分低于 3 分的评价都是针对哪些商品的？列出商品名称和评分

expect.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, r.rating FROM product_reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.rating < 3

question: 北京的客户一共下了多少笔订单？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = '北京'

notes: 单值答案 21

question: 哪些在售（上架）商品从来没有收到过评价？列出 SKU 和商品名称

expect.gold_sql: SELECT p.sku, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND r.id IS NULL

notes: 考察 LEFT JOIN 反连接

question: 所有已退款订单（order_status=60）的订单号、下单客户名称和应付金额是多少？

expect.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_no, c.name, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 60

question: 使用支付宝付款的成功收款记录中，付款金额超过 1000 元的订单有哪些？列出订单号和付款金额

expect.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_no, p.amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.event_type = 'payment' AND p.method = 'alipay' AND p.amount > 1000

question: 哪些已下架商品在历史订单明细中有过销售记录？列出不重复的商品 SKU 和名称

expect.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.is_active = 0

question: 哪些客户购买过“数码电器”分类的商品？列出不重复的客户编号和名称

expect.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_no, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE cat.name = '数码电器'

notes: 考察 5 表关联与去重

question: 各个订单状态分别有多少笔订单？

gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status
SELECT d.dict_label, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'order_status' AND d.dict_value = o.order_status GROUP BY d.dict_label

notes: 状态码或字典中文标签均可

question: 每个下单渠道的订单平均应付金额是多少？

gold_sql: SELECT channel, AVG(total_amount) FROM orders GROUP BY channel
SELECT d.dict_label, AVG(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'channel' AND d.dict_value = o.channel GROUP BY d.dict_label

question: 按全部订单明细的购买件数合计，销量最高的 4 个商品是哪些？给出商品名称和件数

expect.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity) DESC LIMIT 4

notes: 第 4、5 名件数不同（40 与 35），前 4 名内部有并列，因此不比较顺序

question: 哪个商品分类的平均评分最高？给出分类名称和平均分

expect.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM product_reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 按支付方式统计成功收款（event_type='payment'）的笔数和收款总金额

gold_sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE event_type = 'payment' GROUP BY method
SELECT d.dict_label, COUNT(*), SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'method' AND d.dict_value = p.method WHERE p.event_type = 'payment' GROUP BY d.dict_label

question: 统计各个会员等级分别有多少位客户

gold_sql: SELECT member_level, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY member_level
SELECT d.dict_label, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'member_level' AND d.dict_value = c.member_level GROUP BY d.dict_label

question: 哪些城市的客户数量超过 8 位？列出城市名称和客户数

expect.gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 8

notes: 考察 GROUP BY + HAVING

question: 按订单明细的 line_amount 汇总，各个商品分类的明细总金额分别是多少？按金额从高到低排序

expect.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.line_amount) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_amount) DESC

question: 统计有效成交订单（状态为已支付 20、已发货 30 或已完成 40）在每个城市的订单数和应付总金额（total_amount）

expect.gold_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(o.id), SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN (20, 30, 40) GROUP BY c.city

question: 从 payments 表计算全库历史净实收总额（成功收款金额减去成功退款金额，仅统计 status='success'）
